author: GamingBolt
description:
Rockstar Games has finally revealed the big news: It announced that pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 will begin on June 25th. Pre-orders will be available digitally and at other retail stores for PS5 and Xbox Series X.

However, this news also proves one more important point. We discuss that and more in this GTA 6 video.
title: GTA 6 - It's FINALLY Happening

author: GamingBolt
description:
There were years of speculation and rumours, but Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced is real, and we’re onto our second feature highlighting the differences between the upcoming remake and the 2013 original. While previously, we shone the spotlight mostly on visual overhauls and combat improvements, this feature scrutinises the deeper layers of systemic change that are set to reshape how the game plays. 

From frictionless sailing, to combat readability and advanced tools to customise your own immersion, here are fifteen more differences that set Resynced apart from the original Black Flag.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - 15 BIGGEST Improvements Over the Original
